gateway_red.assertion: Commands and bound follow-ups were not consumed; failed sends and unverified destinations did not use the gateway boundary.

recovery_red.assertion: A queued acknowledgement was not delivered by the recovery entry point.

notification_registry_red.assertion: The new transport had two unregistered notification producer sites; both were added as origin-bound replies.

verified: The production Discord event handler dispatches autoship before attachments, history and ordinary inference; WikiQuerier delegates to the shared durable CLI admission adapter.

Immutable configured owner identity and exact live private-channel recipient metadata gate admission and outbound sends. The production HTTP verifier is tested against a local server for owner DM, foreign recipient and group DM responses.

Accepted acknowledgements use atomic single-use dispatch claims, stable enforced nonces and disabled mentions. Exact returned message receipts confirm delivery; failed or lost responses remain uncertain and cannot be blindly replayed.

A single recovery task per broker reads queued acknowledgements at startup and periodically, independently of gateway message replay. It rechecks configured owner and destination before claiming and sending; uncertain acknowledgements are excluded.

The real-Git/scripted-GitHub fixture exercises the production gateway dispatcher and CLI adapter, repeated incoming messages, replay after PR closure, revoked GitHub permission, blocked coding follow-ups and recovery through fresh storage reads.

Conversation routing reads tolerate stores predating Discord admission. Ordinary unbound chat passes through; bound PR follow-ups receive an explicit unavailable response and do not enter wiki inference.
Owner command usage, explicit Slack parity blocker and notification producer registration describe the actual implemented surface.
limits: Only initial PR admission is wired. Native coding follow-ups, workflow selection/control commands, owned-workspace session binding, stage-boundary serialization and provider handoff remain open.

Recovery scans a bounded batch of 128 queued acknowledgements for the configured bot/owner. Retry scheduling, degraded/dead-letter handling and fairness across persistently inaccessible destinations belong to the unfinished delivery service.
Uncertain sends remain parked: bounded remote-history reconciliation and explicit delivery resolution/rebind controls are not implemented. No exactly-once platform delivery claim is made.
Syntax/validation errors and unavailable-follow-up notices are immediate replies, not durable accepted-command acknowledgements.
Durable stage/progress/merge/deployment updates and configured operations routing remain open.
No production rollout, live Discord/native acceptance, paid native end-to-end rerun, hosted CI acceptance or required fault/unattended soak completed in this change.
